calculators.name: Adrenal CT washout
calculators.about: Type the values you have: unenhanced alone, or all three phases, or enhanced and delayed only (relative washout). Delayed phase at 15 minutes. Hypervascular metastases, pheochromocytoma and HCC can wash out too; read it with the rest of the study.
calculators.source: Lipid-rich adenoma: 10 HU or less unenhanced. Washout with a 15-minute delay: absolute 60% or more, relative 40% or more. ACR Incidental Findings Committee white paper on adrenal incidentalomas (J Am Coll Radiol 2017).

rules.text: Consistent with a lipid-rich adenoma (10 HU or less unenhanced).
Consistent with adenoma (absolute washout 60% or more).
Consistent with adenoma (relative washout 40% or more).
Indeterminate: washout below adenoma thresholds (absolute under 60%, relative under 40%).
Indeterminate on unenhanced CT (over 10 HU): washout CT or chemical shift MRI can characterize it.

calculators.sentence: Adrenal nodule[ measuring {u} HU unenhanced][, {e} HU portal venous][, {d} HU at 15 minutes].[ Absolute washout {apw}%.][ Relative washout {rpw}%.] {verdict}

calculators.name: Adrenal MRI chemical shift
calculators.about: Signal intensity of the nodule (and the spleen, for the ratio) on in-phase and opposed-phase images, from regions of interest of the same size and place. The spleen is optional.
calculators.source: Signal intensity index over 16.5% or adrenal-to-spleen ratio under 0.71 (Fujiyoshi et al., Radiology 2003). Published cutoffs vary by study and field strength (lower at 3 T): change them here if your practice uses others.

rules.text: Signal loss on opposed-phase images, consistent with a lipid-rich adenoma.
No significant signal loss on opposed-phase images: indeterminate.

calculators.sentence: Adrenal nodule on chemical shift MRI:[ signal intensity index {sii}%][, adrenal-to-spleen ratio {asr}]. {verdict}

calculators.name: HCC threshold growth
calculators.about: LI-RADS threshold growth: the size (diameter) of a mass goes up by 50% or more in 6 months or less. Measure on the same phase or sequence both times. Also gives the volume doubling time and how long 50% growth takes at this rate.
calculators.source: LI-RADS CT/MRI v2018: threshold growth is a size increase of 50% or more in 6 months or less (a major feature). An unequivocal increase that is not threshold growth is subthreshold growth, an ancillary feature favoring malignancy.

results.label: Time to grow 50% at this rate
results.formula: if(s2 > s1 and days > 0, days * ln(1.5) / ln(s2 / s1))

results.label: Volume doubling time (sphere)
results.formula: if(s2 > s1 and days > 0, days * ln(2) / (3 * ln(s2 / s1)))

rules.text: Check the dates: the current exam must be after the earlier one.
Meets LI-RADS threshold growth (50% or more in 6 months or less).
Grew 50% or more, but over more than 6 months: not LI-RADS threshold growth (subthreshold growth, an ancillary feature).
Not LI-RADS threshold growth (under 50%). An unequivocal increase is subthreshold growth, an ancillary feature.

calculators.sentence: Observation measures {s2} mm[ on {t2}], previously {s1} mm[ on {t1}]:[ {g}% change in size][ over {mo} months]. {verdict}
